name: tiny-tides
description: Tiny Tides — an idle tidepool ecosystem you check on a few times a day.

scripts.test:e2e: node tools/build.mjs --debug && node tools/qa/e2e.mjs && node tools/qa/gacha-e2e.mjs && node tools/qa/regress-e2e.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm test && npm run legal:check:ci && npm run site:check && npm run test:e2e && npm run build
scripts.balance: node tools/qa/balance.mjs && node tools/qa/balance-collector.mjs && node tools/qa/balance-gacha.mjs
scripts.assets: node tools/gen-assets.mjs && npx capacitor-assets generate --ios --iconBackgroundColor '#7f8cff' --splashBackgroundColor '#1b1145' && node tools/slim-splash.mjs
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync ios
scripts.release: npm run lint && npm test && npm run legal:check && npm run site:check && npm run build && npx cap sync ios
